Windows compiler runtime notice

Some Windows binaries dynamically use Microsoft Visual C++ and OpenMP runtime
files, including MSVCP, VCRUNTIME and VCOMP components. These retain Microsoft
copyright and redistribution terms. They are not relicensed under the application's
MIT license. The build uses the licensed Visual Studio environment supplied by the
GitHub-hosted Windows runner, Python and Qt distributions. Preserve vendor notices
and signatures; consult the applicable Visual Studio distributable-code terms:
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/

The native payload inventory identifies the actual runtime files and architecture.
No Microsoft developer installation, paid certificate, or new account is required
on the end user's machine for the complete application package.
